name: DSH Category Star Leaders
description: The highest-starred catalog-admitted entry of each DSH Plugin Marketplace category, mechanically selected from the 2026-08-17 catalog snapshot (3,543 admitted entries). Inclusion states a fact about the catalog; it is not an evaluation or a recommendation. 本整合包按 2026-08-17 目录快照（3543 条收录）机械选取每个分类中 star 数最高的收录条目；收录是事实陈述，不构成评价或推荐。
